title: A flow collection directly after the colon of a plain key
notes: After a plain key, the `:` of a flow mapping entry must be followed by white space before the value (productions 145 and 147); only a JSON-like key, such as a quoted one, may have its value right after the `:` (production 149). In `{a:{}}` the entry `a:` has an empty value and must then end with `,` or `}`, so the second `{`, at column 4, cannot belong to any valid document.

provenance.reference: A reader that accepted a flow collection directly after the colon of a plain key, and an editor that then wrote a replacing scalar against it.
